ai_disclosure: This project used AI (SI) tools: code was generated and refactored with Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code, and Claude chat supported research and planning. All AI output was reviewed and tested by the Field Shift team. See AI_USAGE.md.

sources.name: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources)
sources.what_we_use: Monthly point data for the selected location (T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, T2M_RANGE, RH2M, WS2M, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN, PRECTOTCORR): climatology and FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration (ET0).

sources.name: MODIS MOD13Q1 (Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250 m SIN Grid) via ORNL DAAC TESViS
sources.band: 250m_16_days_NDVI (scale factor 0.0001, fill value -3000, valid range -2000 to 10000, as reported by the API's /MOD13Q1/bands)
sources.version: TODO verify — the API does not state the collection in its responses; the TESViS documentation's example filenames show collection 006
sources.access_method: TESViS RESTful Web Service: /MOD13Q1/bands, /MOD13Q1/dates, /MOD13Q1/subset with kmAboveBelow=0 and kmLeftRight=0 (single 250 m pixel), at most ten MODIS dates per request (per the service documentation), one band per request.
sources.what_we_use: 16-day NDVI at the clicked pixel for the last three full years, to show greenness seasons as supporting evidence next to the crop calendar. Not used in any score.
sources.citation: ORNL DAAC. 2018. Terrestrial Ecology Subsetting & Visualization Services (TESViS) RESTful Web Service. ORNL DAAC, Oak Ridge, Tennessee, USA. https://doi.org/10.3334/ORNLDAAC/1600
sources.citation_source: https://modis.ornl.gov/data/modis_webservice.html (Tool Citation); https://modis.ornl.gov/citation.html asks to cite both the tool and the data product
sources.product_citation: TODO — add the MOD13Q1 product citation

sources.name: ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0
sources.what_we_use: Topsoil clay/sand/silt %, pH and organic carbon at the selected point.

sources.name: FAO ECOCROP
sources.what_we_use: Crop requirement envelopes (temperature, rainfall, pH, killing temperature, cycle length) and botanical family for data/crops.json, built by scripts/build_crops.py.
sources.origin_per_repo: OpenCLIM/ecocrop README: "The full FAO EcoCrop database (https://gaez.fao.org/pages/ecocrop) is provided as EcoCrop_DB.csv."
sources.license_per_repo: The repository has no LICENSE file and GitHub reports no license. README 'License information': "This code is available under the terms of the Open Government Licence" and "By accessing or using this dataset, you agree to the terms of the Open Government Licence" (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). CITATION.cff: "license: OGL-UK-3.0" with "type: software".
sources.license: UNVERIFIED — team must confirm before submission
sources.license_note: OGL is the repository authors' (UKCEH) licence; the data originates from FAO, whose own terms for ECOCROP were not found in the repo. Check FAO's terms before submission.
sources.citation: Brown, M. J., Redhead, J., Pywell, R., Price, J. EcoCrop Climatic Crop Suitability Scoring. doi:10.5281/zenodo.10843625

sources.name: FAO GAEZ (Global Agro-Ecological Zones)
sources.what_we_use: TODO: reference for cross-checking crop suitability results.

sources.name: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 (Crop Evapotranspiration)
sources.what_we_use: Penman-Monteith ET0 (Ch. 2-4), crop coefficients Kc ini/mid/end (Table 12, in data/kc_fao56.json, provisional) and ETc = Kc × ET0.

sources.name: USDA FAS GAIN report EG2024-0011, Sugar Annual (Cairo, Egypt)
sources.what_we_use: Table 'Government Procurement Prices Announced in February 2024': procurement / guaranteed prices (EGP/t) for wheat, maize, rice, soybean, sunflower, cotton and sugar beet in data/market_egypt.json; implied sunflower and cotton yields.

sources.name: USDA FAS GAIN report EG2024-0023, Grain and Feed Update (Cairo, Egypt, 25 Sep 2024)
sources.what_we_use: Post estimates MY2024/25 for wheat, maize and rice area and production (national average yields in data/market_egypt.json).

sources.name: USDA FAS GAIN report EG2024-0008, Oilseeds and Products Annual (Cairo, Egypt, 4 Apr 2024)
sources.url_note: Third-party mirror recorded in data/market_egypt.json; the official GAIN download URL is TODO.
sources.what_we_use: Soybean national average yield in data/market_egypt.json.

sources.name: USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer (CDL) via CropScape
sources.access_method: GetCDLValue?year=YYYY&x=X&y=Y with x/y in USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic (USGS version), EPSG:5070, reprojected with pyproj. One 30 m pixel per year, last 6 available years (2020-2025 on 2026-11-15).
sources.legend: Official NASS legend data/raw/cdl_codes_names.xlsx (https://www.nass.usda.gov/sites/default/files/Research_and_Science/Cropland/docs/cdl_codes_names.xlsx); mapping to crop ids in data/cdl_crop_map.json (unverified).
sources.what_we_use: Yearly crop class at the clicked field to detect the farmer's current rotation for US points (/api/field-history; /api/compare when current_rotation is omitted).
